Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: The Devourer
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Tzimisce
Capacity: 7
Discipline: AUS POT FOR PRO VIC
Sabbat. Red List: During your untap phase, burn a younger vampire you control. If you do, The Devourer gains 1 capacity, +1 strength and +1 bleed for the remainder of the game, and all the blood that vampire had. He cannot have or use equipment. Blood hunts cannot be called on him.

Thoughts? Comments?

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Surreal
Messages.Body: Those kind of cards with weird new effects are hardest to play test and something might slip through playtesting. It also limits future card design because you have to think how some cards affects with The Devourer. Like some new cards (lets say cheap sabbat style embrace with shock troops theme) could be totally balanced without already exciting card with weird special. Minor point but my point is more what is wrong with more simple design. It is easiest to design wonky cards with weird specials. Designing a solid cards which offers new strategy or card choices without needing completely new abilites or mechanisms are the best cards IMO and also hardest to design.
